# Rooms and prices

![Lake-view double room in Swiss stone pine, with a balcony](../../../assets/doppelzimmer.jpg)

Every room has its own bathroom, Wi-Fi and furniture made of local Swiss stone pine. The rooms on the south side have a balcony overlooking Lake Sils.

| Room | Size | Price per night |
|---|---|---|
| Forest single room | 18 m² | CHF 180 |
| Lake-view double room | 26 m² | CHF 320 |
| Family room | 38 m² | CHF 420 |

Prices are per room and night, including breakfast and the visitor tax. Dogs are welcome: CHF 25 per night.

## Booking

Call us on +41 81 555 01 10 or write to info@laerchenwald.example. We confirm every booking within a day.
